old: Because it was fitted to gases and is extrapolated to liquids without justification.
new: Because its polynomial was fitted to dilute gas data and is then extrapolated to dense liquids without justification.

old: Either, since both are correlations and the tier difference reflects documentation.
new: Either, since both are correlations underneath and the tier difference reflects only how thoroughly each is documented.

old: Because the total is measured and the split is predicted, so only the split can be wrong.
new: Because the total is measured in the laboratory and the split is predicted by the model, so only the split has any room to be wrong.

old: Because the total is a sum of stage volumes whose individual errors cancel exactly.
new: Because the total is a sum of stage volumes whose individual errors cancel exactly, leaving the aggregate right while each stage stays off.

old: In an appendix only, so it cannot be lifted into a summary and quoted as measured.
new: In an appendix only, so it cannot be lifted into an executive summary and quoted as measured.

old: It is above the measured value, since the untuned bias is only partly corrected.
new: It is above the measured value, since the regression only partly corrects the untuned model's high bias.

old: It is larger than the characterized value, since the correction increases the translation.
new: It is larger than the characterized value, since the regression pushes the translation further to correct the density.

old: Each depends on the volume shift, the knob that moves furthest and dominates the fit.
new: Each depends on the volume shift, the knob that moves furthest from its starting value and therefore dominates the fit to every target.

old: Each tuned the model further, so the description improved monotonically across the three.
new: Each tuned the model further than the tier before, so the fluid description improved monotonically from one tier to the next.

old: Because the linear rule is exact and the quadratic one is an approximation adopted for tractability.
new: Because the linear rule is exact and the quadratic one is an approximation adopted so that the cubic can still be solved analytically.

old: A measure of how strongly two components repel, fitted to their mixture's excess volume.
new: A measure of how strongly two components repel at short range, fitted to the excess volume their mixture shows on blending.

old: A scaling on the covolume of a pair, which corrects for the packing of unlike molecules.
new: A scaling on the covolume of a pair, which corrects for the less efficient packing of unlike molecules of very different sizes.

old: Equal chemical potential for every component, from which the fugacities follow by exponentiation.
new: Equal chemical potential for every component, from which the fugacities follow by exponentiation without needing an equation of state at all.

old: Equal K values across components, which is what the Rachford-Rice equation enforces.
new: Equal K values across components, which is what the Rachford-Rice equation enforces when it solves for the vapour fraction of the feed.

old: The Jacobian is singular when two knobs affect the same target identically, which the volume shift and the shift multiplier do.
new: The Jacobian is singular when two knobs affect the same target identically, which the volume shift and the shift multiplier do, so the normal equations cannot be inverted.

old: The Jacobian is computed once at the starting point and reused, which is invalid once the knobs have moved substantially.
new: The Jacobian is computed once at the starting point and reused on every iteration, which is invalid once the knobs have moved substantially from their initial values.

old: The knobs, the bounds, the solver, the iteration count and the final residual.
new: The knobs, the bounds, the solver, the iteration count and the final residual at convergence.

old: Fitted, because it suggests a statistical procedure where this was a physically bounded optimisation.
new: Fitted, because it suggests a statistical procedure with confidence intervals where this was a physically bounded optimisation.

old: A tighter prior pull, which holds the under-determined knobs at their starting values and thereby removes the ambiguity.
new: A tighter prior pull, which holds the under-determined knobs at their starting values and thereby removes the ambiguity from the reported fit.

old: A covariance matrix from the converged Jacobian, which quantifies the uncertainty in each knob directly.
new: A covariance matrix from the converged Jacobian, which quantifies the uncertainty in each knob directly and so removes the need for any reruns.

old: When the fluid is near its critical point, where a two-pseudo-component description fails entirely.
new: When the fluid is near its critical point, where a two-pseudo-component description fails entirely and liquid shrinkage becomes unpredictable.

old: When the total gas-oil ratio is the answer, since the approximation is least reliable in the aggregate.
new: When the total gas-oil ratio is the answer, since the approximation is least reliable in the aggregate where the stage errors accumulate.

old: To full precision with a footnote, so that a later reader can reproduce the calculation exactly.
new: To full precision with a footnote, so that a later reader can reproduce the calculation exactly and check each intermediate step.

old: Only in an appendix, so that it cannot be lifted into a summary and quoted as though it were measured.
new: Only in an appendix, so that it cannot be lifted into an executive summary and quoted in a decision as though it were measured.

old: What each number is, because the definitions involve reference conditions that vary between reports.
new: What each number is, because the definitions involve reference conditions of pressure and temperature that vary between reports.

old: Because the temperature at which the chain is evaluated is not stated, and viscosity depends strongly on it.
new: Because the temperature at which the chain is evaluated is not stated, and dead oil viscosity falls steeply as the reservoir temperature rises.

old: The composition of the liberated gas, since only its gravity is reported rather than a full analysis.
new: The composition of the liberated gas, since only its specific gravity is reported at each depletion step rather than a full analysis.

old: Nothing measurable changes, because the tank releases only a few percent of the total gas at these conditions.
new: Nothing measurable changes, because the stock tank releases only a few percent of the total gas at these conditions and the error sits inside the laboratory scatter.

old: Compatibility, since a split composition can no longer be compared against the laboratory's reported analysis.
new: Compatibility, since a split composition can no longer be compared line by line against the laboratory's reported analysis of the plus fraction.

old: A simplification should be stated only when its cost is material, since caveats on negligible effects dilute the report.
new: A simplification should be stated only when its cost is material, since caveats on negligible effects dilute the report and train readers to skip over the ones that matter.

old: A simplification should be removed rather than documented, since a documented limitation is one nobody will read.
new: A simplification should be removed rather than documented, since a documented limitation is one nobody will read, and the extra physics costs less than the lost credibility.

old: Confirm the composition sums to one and the Watson factor is plausible, which validates the two measured inputs.
new: Confirm the composition sums to one and the Watson characterization factor is plausible, which validates the two measured inputs.

old: Check that the model returns a formation volume factor at reservoir conditions, since a null indicates a problem.
new: Check that the model returns a formation volume factor at reservoir conditions, since a null there indicates a broken characterization.

old: Use one only for properties that do not enter the final answer, and measure everything that does.
new: Use one only for properties that do not enter the final answer, and send everything that does to the laboratory for measurement.

old: Because the data set is larger, operators accumulating far more measurements than any single publication.
new: Because the data set is larger, operators accumulating far more measurements over decades than any single publication could.

old: Because the fitting is done more carefully, being checked against wells the company can go back to.
new: Because the fitting is done more carefully, with each point checked against wells the company can go back to and resample.
